raw_text: DRDO cyber attack has defence research community on high alert. Supply chain compromise through an IT vendor is a sophisticated tactic that bypasses perimeter security. The custom malware was disguised as a routine update for lab management systems. Multiple DRDO facilities may have been exposed. NIA investigation is underway. This highlights the need for vendor security audits.
clean_text: DRDO supply chain cyber attack alarms defence research community. Malware disguised as lab software update bypassed perimeter security. Multiple facilities potentially exposed. NIA investigating.
